**Finding: compliant** (no redline).

The only MFN-type language in this Agreement benefits us: in Attachment 1, "MSL agrees that MSL engineering will be priced to IBM on a 'most favored customer' basis." That is a vendor-granted MFN, which the playbook expressly welcomes.

I checked the pricing architecture (§ 7.1 manufacturing/fulfillment price formula, § 7.2 RS product and integration pricing, and the Markup Appendix references) and ran targeted searches for the usual MFN triggers — "most favored", "no less favorable", "best price", "favorable", "match", and third-party terms. Nothing obliges IBM to give MSL terms no less favourable than those offered to any third party, and there is no right for MSL to match third-party offers. This sits at the preferred position, so no changes are needed.
